heading: Our Mission and Vision
mission: To provide accessible, child-centered developmental care that empowers every family.
vision: To become the most trusted center for pediatric developmental support in the region.
description: Vathsalya CNNC was founded with a mission to bridge clinical expertise and compassionate care. Our interdisciplinary team works closely with families to understand each child's strengths and challenges.
From early intervention to long-term developmental support, we create practical, individualized plans that improve outcomes at home, in school, and in social environments.
